title: Mola Cheekh Kar Roye
body:
Bawaqte ghusle masooma jo maula chikh kar roye
Na jane kya nazar aya jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda ke sher ne hans hans ke sare dard sah dale
magar ye dard tha kaisa jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitamgaron ne jane kis tarah binte payambar ko
Daro diwar me peesa jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Udhar hilne lagi qabre payambar arsh kanp uttha
Idhar bacchon ko ghash aya jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Tadap kar shabbaro shabbiro zainab ne kiya matam
Padha kulsoom ne nauha jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Faza me goonj utthi phir sada subbat alayya ki
Bawqte rukhsate zahra jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zami,n hilne lagi arshe ilahi gham se tharraya
Hua ik hashr sa barpa jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Gaye hasbe wasiyyat ghusl dene jab shahe safdar
To tadpa lashaye zahra jo maula chikh kar roye
<<DIVIDER>>
Belale kazmi socho rasoole haq ki beti par
Huye the zulm akhir kya jo maula chikh kar roye
author: Bilal Kazmi
